topic: Documenting workplace harassment vs verbal complaints (Neil vs Wren)

scenes.narration: Screenshots won her a thirty five thousand dollar settlement. Court is in session!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera at the bench holding up a phone showing screenshots, comic burst banner reads THIRTY FIVE THOUSAND, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neil and Wren work at the same company under the same manager.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man neil and woman wren at office cubicles, the same boss visible behind a glass wall, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Both face the same string of inappropriate emails and meetings.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two computer screens with identical red marked emails labeled INAPPROPRIATE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neil complains verbally to HR and trusts the system.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, neil in an HR office talking, an HR rep nodding politely, a blank notepad on the desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: He keeps no copies of the messages on his work laptop.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, neil shutting his work laptop with no files saved, an empty USB drive on the desk, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wren saves every email to a personal account each day.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wren at a coffee shop laptop forwarding emails to a folder labeled EVIDENCE LOG, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: She dates incidents and screenshots inappropriate chats into a folder.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wren tagging dated screenshots into a private cloud folder labeled INCIDENT LOG, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Three months later both file lawsuits against the same manager.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, both neil and wren in suits at a courthouse, lawyers beside them, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Neil's case dismissed because the company wiped his work laptop.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shocked neil at a courtroom table with empty hands, a wiped laptop screen showing NO DATA beside him, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Wren's lawsuit ends in a thirty five thousand dollar settlement.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, wren holding a settlement check labeled THIRTY FIVE THOUSAND, a written apology letter beside her, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Her timeline and screenshots proved every single claim in court.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a courtroom screen displaying wren's dated screenshots, each marked with a green CHECK, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Document everything in writing. Verbal complaints disappear. Court dismissed!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named judge vera, silver hair in a neat bun, sharp dark eyes, black judge robes with a gold gavel badge, holding wooden gavel, judge vera banging her gavel, holding a phone with a folder reading EVIDENCE LOG, comic banner reads SAVE EVERYTHING, kids comic book illustration
